name: dprk-entity-resolution
description: DPRK Entity Resolution Engine – complete Python application for ingesting UN sanctions-report PDFs, extracting entity mentions, embedding them in LanceDB, proposing alias pairs, and providing analyst review workflow.

sessions.summary: Built the complete DPRK Entity Resolution Engine from spec. All 10 layers implemented (types, ingest, parse, extract, embed, resolve, review, storage, api, cli). 48 Python source files. 94 tests passing, 0 failing. Layer-order architectural rules enforced via AST-based structural tests. All imports verified.
